proposal.name: Limits come from config
proposal.description: Use when adding a limit, threshold, window or cap: read it through loadConfig() with a default, never as a constant.
proposal.rule: Every limit, threshold, window and cap is read through loadConfig() from an env var with a default. Add a config test for the default and one for the override. A reviewer flags a constant limit as a finding.
